name: Wizard Jewels
author: Addicting Games
description: Wizard Jewels is a puzzle game made for wizards! It doesn’t matter what house you’re from, you’ll enjoy this magical-based matching game. This isn’t your basic matching game. It’s 3 games in one with 3 different ways to match the jewels. Additionally, one of your objectives is to make the backgrounds completely disappear. To do this, you match the jewels and the backgrounds will go POOF! Once you’ve done this, you have to use your magic to get a key to its destination. There are 50 levels waiting for you to cast your spell! Click on the play button, and get to playing this unique matching game that will give you more of a challenge.
